messages:
alex: Quick ask — need a short window to capture full request + response bodies for ~50 failing production requests to debug a generation regression. Will redact tokens and PII; need sec sign-off + temporary S3 access.

maria: Is this for streaming or non-streaming responses? Also what exact fields are you planning to capture (headers, tokens, prompt text)?

alex: Non-streaming only. Plan: capture request body (prompt text), response text, and request headers except Authorization/Cookie. We will NOT persist raw token streams — only token_count and the final text. We will hash user identifiers and mask emails/phones.

nish: Need details: where will data land, KMS/CMK, retention TTL, who gets access, and a ticket with justification. No raw auth tokens or keys can be saved.

alex: Target bucket: s3://redwood-ephemeral-debug/infra/2105006789. Use customer-managed KMS key (redwood-debug-cmk). Retention: 24 hours. Access limited to: alex, jeff, and maria. JIRA: INF-2345 (linked in the ticket contains sample ids).

maria: Ok but require explicit scrub rules for headers and body fields. Can you paste the exact redaction config you'll run?

alex: Sure — config snippet we plan to use:
```
mask_rules: [
  {type: "header", keys: ["Authorization", "Cookie"]},
  {type: "body_regex", pattern: "[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{4}", mask: "<PHONE>"},
  {type: "body_field_hash", fields: ["user_id", "email"], hash_salt: "redwood-salt-v1"}
]
store: s3://redwood-ephemeral-debug/infra/2105006789
retention: 24h
audit: true
```
We will also drop any `token` or `raw_prompt_tokens` fields if present.

nish: Good. Add these constraints before approval: 1) ticket must list specific request ids or sampling filter, 2) policy review sign-off (that's us), 3) timebox auto-delete job scheduled, 4) IAM role with MFA only. Also we need proof that Authorization/Cookie are redacted at capture time (not post-ingest).

alex: Acknowledged. Sampling filter we'll use: `error=true OR latency_ms>500 OR generation_similarity_score<0.8` — capped to 50 requests. I'll update INF-2345 with the IDs and sampling filter and attach the redaction script.

jeff: Quick question — will this capture any KV cache content (from streaming or context cache)? We must avoid caching secrets.

alex: No KV captures. We only snapshot the final request/response artifacts. Streaming frames and internal KV cache are excluded by the collector.

sre_oncall: For operations: ensure the lifecycle job runs as a cron job that deletes objects older than 24h and emits a deletion event to audit logs. Also attach a retention proof to the ticket.

sec_bot: Audit note: created audit_log entry for INF-2345 and flagged for review by eng-security.

maria: Conditional +1 from me if the ticket contains the sampling ids, the scrub config runs at collection, CMK is used, and IAM list matches the participants.

nish: I reviewed INF-2345 and the redaction script. Provided the CMK and IAM roles are configured as described and deletion job is scheduled, I approve this for a 12 hour window starting now. Please keep the capture capped at 50 samples and send an update when deletion completes.

alex: Thanks all — kicking off the capture now (window: 12h). Will post when deletion job runs. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345

sec_bot: Audit note: capture approved by nish; approval expiry ts: 2105010389.
